notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41409941/ea6b48c37028495cb6fd12a2ff486a0a7e4724c6.png

Hey guys!

Opus Castle is already going through the third update and we wanted to thank you for all the feedback you are giving and you can be assured that the entire game improvement process is thanks to you!

So, follow the changes that were made this week in this our third patch that is already available.


Patch 1.0.3

Highlights

 Tutorial for mobile was added in-game;
 Fixed a bug when the player pressing the "+" button the character increases in size;


Improvements

 Audio added to the character's speech in the start of Chapter 2 cinematics;
 Mother's Cinematics caption from Chapter 1 changed "para" by "Sarah";



If you have any problems with the game or find any bugs, let us know on the Steam forum!




Thanks everyone and have a great week!

notes.title: Update 1.0.1
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41409941/65645a3e80e05578790fd051166105539ee29880.jpg

Hello guys!

We are very happy with the release of the first two chapters of Opus Castle and we are closely following all the gameplay and analysis about the game.

We are aware of certain bugs that players are reporting to us and at this first moment, we are here to let everyone know that changes are already being made and our first patch is now available.

Update 1.0.1

Highlights

 Motion blur has been removed from the game (for now).
 Now a "press to open" message will appear on the pantry door.
 Added an instruction screen with all the buttons and their functions in the game.


Improvements

 Fixed the bug where the character kept appearing on the ceiling of certain environments.
 Fixed the problem where the child didn't show up in the first cutscene of Chapter 2.
 Removed the skip button from last cutscene.


If you have any problems with the game or found any bugs, let us know on the game's forum so we can analyze it!
